title: T-COMP-PT v1.0: A provenance-controlled experimental thermography benchmark and curved-sequence registry for composite defect detection
description: A complete 1,034-frame expert-annotated public CFRP thermography benchmark with paired hashes and provenance, plus an authoritative registry for twelve planar, curved, and trapezoidal CFRP/GFRP pulsed-thermography sequences.
notes: Confirm author order, affiliations, ORCIDs, repository URL, and contributor roles before publication. The included public pixels require primary-source attribution.
